items.reason: GET handlers already migrated to withCanonicalEnforcement and safely using ctx.policy with fallback pattern
items.notes: No migration needed. Pattern is safe and operational.

items.reason: POST/PATCH handlers require policy context for mutations but withCanonicalEnforcement wrapper design undefined for passing policy to handler
items.required_design_decision: Should withCanonicalEnforcement expose ctx.policy for POST handlers? If yes, how should policy be computed in wrapper? If no, separate wrapper needed?
items.notes: Requires design decision: (1) Extend withCanonicalEnforcement to support policy context in POST/PATCH, or (2) Create separate wrapper for policy-aware mutations

items.reason: Services contain policy logic for admin overrides and cross-workspace checks. Route migration cannot proceed without service refactoring.
items.notes: Out of scope for route-level migration. Requires separate service-level refactoring lane.

overall_assessment: Lane 7 cannot proceed with direct migration without design phase. GET handlers are already safe. POST/PATCH handlers require wrapper design decision. Service-level patterns are blocked and belong to separate lane.
